labels._title: The order service writes the ORDER and EVENT tables in one local transaction, then the event publisher queries the EVENT table and publishes to the message broker
labels._desc: The order service inserts one row into the ORDER table (909, 101, NEW, 1234) and one into the EVENT table (84784, Order Created, {...}, NEW) with two INSERTs in a single local transaction. The event publisher queries the EVENT table and publishes the event to the message broker on the right.
